page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.4xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on the KVM hypervisor. Hardware compute is delivered by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8475B processor based on the x86_64 architecture, providing 16 dedicated vCPUs. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB allocated per virtual core.

The server does not include bundled local disk storage, requiring external cloud block storage for operating system installation and application data persistence. Dedicated GPUs are not present on this hardware configuration. Network performance features a baseline throughput of 12 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

The 1:4 resource profile yields balanced operational capacity for steady CPU and memory demands without the resource premiums of specialized memory-heavy or compute-heavy families. The architecture is suited for enterprise backends, containerized cluster nodes, relational database hosting, and general web applications.
